did_you_know.fact: On July 29, 587 BCE: The Neo-Babylonian Empire sacks Jerusalem and destroys the First Temple.
July 29 is observed as Earliest day on which Somer's Day can fall, while August 4 is the latest; celebrated on Friday before the first Monday in August. (Bermuda).
On July 29, 1973: Greeks vote to abolish the monarchy, beginning the first period of the Metapolitefsi.
July 29 is observed as Ólavsøka or Olsok, opening of the Løgting session. (Faroe Islands and the Nordic countries).
